ridgecv_ff_blocked.note: RidgeCV's float-float fallback (the only route when the float32 Gram cannot be factored): every float-float statistic becomes FOLD_BLOCK-row block partials (one thread per (statistic, block), the rw_gram_parts_kernel shape) folded blocks ascending, and the float-float Cholesky of each untrusted alpha runs on one block team (t_cholesky split, every entry its own chain) in one launch per fold instead of grid 1 / block 1 per alpha. The Ridge refit (_ridge_ff_grid) takes the same blocked statistics and team solve. Host column (ridgecv.mojo _kf_ff_stats_host, ridge.mojo _ridge_ff_host) folds the same blocks. Bits change (block fold order); NV and AMD must match per arm. Cost reasoning: same work, n/FOLD_BLOCK times the threads in flight; no shape rule. NOT COMPILED (lanes never compile), NOT MEASURED.

enetcv_score_blocks.note: Arm value = rows of the fold's span per score block (fixed count, not a data shape; legal set enforced in core/six_lane_experiment_guards.mojo). The held-out squared errors of every path point become (path, alpha, row-block) partials: block (path, b) stages its rows in the staged kernel's tiles, thread k folds alpha k from zero; a thread per (path, alpha) folds the partials blocks ascending (fold_parts). Replaces ecv_score_staged_kernel's one block per (fold, l1_ratio) path over all held-out rows. Host column (cd.mojo esb_host_score) folds the same blocks. Bits change (fold order); NV and AMD must match per arm. Requires the staged score page (comptime assert). NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.
